themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, and make decisions within research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, often integrated into IDEs or development workflows.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights a broad category of AI-powered platforms and software designed to facilitate various aspects of research, from data analysis to insight generation.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the use, impact, and research findings related to AI-powered conversational agents and their role in information gathering and interaction.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles focusing on how AI is being integrated into product development, strategy, and management processes.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores the application of AI in understanding user needs, generating design ideas, and evaluating design effectiveness.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Covers AI applications that enhance survey creation, distribution, analysis, and the insights derived from survey data.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial user profiles or data for testing, simulation, or research purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI capabilities that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for quicker comprehension.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Articles that discuss AI's role in automating various stages of software and system testing, including self-healing and efficiency.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
